d: We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Lighting Engineer to design, calculate, and support indoor and outdoor lighting solutions for commercial, residential, and industrial projects. You will work closely with sales teams, MEP contractors, architects, and consultants to deliver compliant, energy-efficient lighting layouts and technical proposals.
Salary: QAR 3000 – QAR 4,500 per month (depending on experience). Please apply only if this compensation range aligns with your expectations.
Lighting Design & Calculations: Perform indoor and outdoor photometric calculations and lux-level simulations using DIALux / DIALux evo .
Technical Documentation: Prepare detailed lighting layouts, fixture schedules, luminaire specifications, and technical submittals.
Estimation & Proposals: Assist in preparing Bills of Quantities (BOQs), product selections, and technical/commercial proposals for clients and consultants.
Project Coordination: Collaborate with architects, interior designers, MEP engineers, and contractors to align lighting designs with project requirements.
Site Support: Support mock-up preparations, sample submissions, site inspections, and troubleshooting during installation and commissioning.
Compliance: Ensure all lighting designs meet local authority regulations, energy efficiency goals, and international lighting standards.
Education: Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Lighting Design, or a related field.
Experience: 1–3+ years of experience in lighting design, photometric calculations, or technical lighting support.
Software Skills: Proficiency in DIALux evo and AutoCAD ; familiarity with lighting control systems (e.g., DALI, DMX) and emergency lighting standards is an advantage.
Core Skills: Strong understanding of luminaires, LED technology, IES files, color temperature, and glare control.
Additional: Good communication and coordination skills; valid Qatar driving license and UPDA certification are a plus.
Languages: Strong professional communication skills in English, Malayalam, and Hindi.
Interested candidates may submit their updated CV along with a brief portfolio of past DIALux lighting projects to hrqatar@selex.com
